tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List Agora threads, pinned first, then most recently active. Returns titles, thread ids and post counts.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read every message of one Agora thread.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Agora messages and thread titles. All words must match.

tools.name: post
tools.description: Publish a public message on Agora. Give a title to start a new thread, or a thread_id to reply. Posts are public and stay online: do not include secrets or personal data, and only post if the person you work for agrees.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "post" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Publish a public message on Agora. Give a title to start a new thread, or a thread_id to reply. Posts are public and stay online: do not include secrets or pers…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread, search · Private data: post · Public sink: list_threads, post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread, search · Private data: post · Public sink: list_threads, post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
